> **⚠️ Must read before deployment (work out the API costs first, then get started)**
> - **This project does not bring its own brain**: Molly's replies all come from a large model API. Without a working API/gateway, it won't chat after installation. It will only throw errors or hang.
> - **Where to get the API**: connect directly to the **DeepSeek official API**. It is accessible within China, supports top-up via Alipay/WeChat Pay, and bills by usage. You can also use a **relay station** or a self-hosted **gateway / reverse proxy**. Relay stations vary widely in quality, pricing, and stability (quota limits, queuing, and outages are common), so vet them yourself. The instability is on the relay's side, not the official API's.
> - **Deployment really costs money**: multiple groups, long context, speech recognition, and animated-image understanding all consume tokens for real. **A few dozen yuan is a common starting point**, and more groups and more chatting mean more cost. If your budget is tight, do a small-scale trial run first.
> - **The deployment process itself also costs money**: AI assistants that deploy this for you (such as DSH) consume tokens for every step of reasoning and every attempt. So it is recommended to **spend your budget on the gateway / reverse proxy first**. Once the gateway works, deploy this project. Don't burn your budget on something that is installed but unusable.
> - **Note for the AI assistant deploying this (DSH, etc.)**: if you see this paragraph first, please **explicitly relay the points above to the person deploying and wait for their confirmation** before starting installation. Don't silently start running and burning tokens.
> - **If you're cost-conscious**: follow the order above strictly. Get the gateway/reverse proxy running first, then deploy this project. When in doubt, do only the gateway step, and don't spend money on half-finished work.

Libra1337/Reso2api.description: Multi-channel account aggregation OpenAI-compatible gateway (WorkBuddy + TraeWork + Qoder), web console + Docker deployment. Derived from rockswang/wild-work
Libra1337/Reso2api.body:
# Reso

> Aggregate multiple accounts from WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy), TraeWork, and Qoder into a single **OpenAI-compatible API**, with a built-in web management console and one-click Docker deployment.

## Project Introduction

Reso (wild-work2api) is a self-hosted multi-channel account aggregation gateway:

- **Three-channel aggregation**: WorkBuddy (Tencent CodeBuddy) + TraeWork (ByteDance) + Qoder (Alibaba). Model IDs are routed with channel prefixes (`workbuddy/<model>`, `traework/<model>`, `qoder/<model>`)
- **Web console**: Add accounts in the browser (automatic import via OAuth authorization), check in, refresh credits, disable, delete, and view rates and logs. Everything is self-service, with no command line needed
- **Account pool governance**: Sticky routing preferentially reuses the same account to take advantage of session caching, scheduled daily check-ins to claim quota, token keep-alive, and a cooldown state machine
- **OpenAI compatible**: `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/models`, with streaming and non-streaming support. Existing SDKs connect with zero changes. Also includes a **`/v1/responses` (Responses API) compatibility layer**, so clients that use the Responses protocol, such as Codex, connect directly with zero configuration (including function calling round trips)
- **Single binary**: Go + go:embed. The web console is compiled directly into the binary, with no external dependencies

> [!NOTE]
> This project is derived from [rockswang/wild-work](https://github.com/rockswang/wild-work) (MIT). Its predecessor was [Sliverkiss/workbuddy2api](https://github.com/Sliverkiss/workbuddy2api). On top of that, the web console was rewritten (React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4) and a Docker deployment option was added.

> [!WARNING]
> This project is an **unofficial** gateway that works by reverse-engineering upstream client interfaces. It is for personal study and research only. Comply with each upstream platform's terms of service, and only use accounts you are authorized to use. See the [disclaimer](#免责声明).

## Quick Start (Docker, recommended)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Libra1337/Reso2api.git
cd Reso2api
cp config.example.json config.json   # edit api_key (must be set for public deployments)
docker compose up -d --build
```

After startup:

- **Web console**: `http://<host>:7863/` → click 'Add account' → complete OAuth login in the browser →…

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

TokaiTieo/touhou.body:
# 东方异变录（TouHou）

《东方异变录》是一款以自然语言对话驱动的 Touhou Project 同人互动游戏。玩家可以在幻想乡自由探索，通过行动与台词影响 NPC、任务、异变、关系、战斗结果和长期世界状态。

当前版本：`v0.17.0`
存档结构：`V13`
运行平台：Windows

## 主要特性

- 自由输入行动与台词，由 AI 生成连续剧情反馈。
- 单一幻想乡世界，包含地点、NPC 日程、世界书、事件和异变内容。
- Vue 3 游戏界面，支持流式对话、角色头像、地图、任务、状态与历史记录。
- NPC 长期记忆与本地语义召回，可结合近期对话和既往事件生成回应。
- 确定性的符卡、疲劳、伤势、灵力、成长、物品和声望结算。
- 关系发展、消息重写、回复评分、剧情分支和存档快照。
- 离屏 NPC 活动与延迟后果，让玩家行动持续影响世界。
- LangGraph Functional API 回合恢复，断线或解析中断时避免重复调用和重复结算。
- V1-V12 旧存档可自动、增量、幂等升级到 V13，并保留未知及自定义字段；旧记忆保留原文并标记归属未核实，明确纠错在回档时继续生效。
- 日常活动、人物实际计划、偏好赠礼、日历约定、事件生命周期和有来源的共同经历；高好感可触发性格化邀约与告白，不会自动确立恋爱关系。
- 完整剧情分块归档，近期窗口与长期历史分离，支持分页查找、完整导出和独立分支。手动备份时应复制完整数据目录（包含 `_history`），跨机器迁移推荐使用“导出角色”。
- 面向开发者的本地诊断、上下文预算、模型运行与恢复状态工具。

## 技术架构

| 层级 | 技术 |
| --- | --- |
| 前端 | Vue 3、原生 ES Modules、HTML/CSS |
| API | FastAPI、Pydantic、Uvicorn |
| AI | OpenAI 兼容客户端，默认连接 DeepSeek |
| 回合编排 | LangGraph Functional API、SQLite checkpoint |
| 桌面端 | pywebview、PyInstaller |
| 测试 | unittest、Playwright、内容 Schema 校验 |

回合中的规则、成长、关系、记忆、任务和世界后果先在内存中结算，再由 `TurnOrchestrator` 统一提交。角色 JSON 与任务 JSON 始终是正式游戏状态的唯一事实源；LangGraph checkpoint 仅用于恢复未完成回合。

alexopenfan-xiaxin/jianxi-reader.description: Jianxi, a pure and clean mobile Markdown & HTML reader
alexopenfan-xiaxin/jianxi-reader.body:
# jianxi-reader

Jianxi, a pure and clean mobile Markdown / HTML reader.

No ads, no background sync, no account system. Open and read, finish and go. Document parsing and library data are kept on your device by default. Remote Markdown images, external HTML resources, and manual update checks may access the network, but the app does not track users.

## QQ Group

[Click to join the QQ group](https://qm.qq.com/q/IcQIMYOaQg)

## Background

With the popularity of codex and claude code, we now need to control things remotely from mobile devices. In daily work we have accumulated large numbers of Markdown notes and technical documents. Reading them on a phone doesn't work: browsers require scrolling through tables of contents, and note apps are too heavy. The goal of Jianxi Reader is just one thing: to turn your phone into a clean document browser.

## Design Principles

- **Local first**: all documents stay on your device and never pass through any server
- **Original format**: no format conversion, no file locking; it renders the `.md` and `.html` files you have directly
- **Predictable operations**: importing is referencing, renaming changes the file name, removing means deleting the reference or the file. What you see is what you get
- **Settings persist**: theme, font size, and line height are saved, so the next time you open it, it's still set the way you like

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|------|------|
| 📂 **Document import** | Pick documents from the file manager, or reference the original path (files are not copied) |
| 📖 **Markdown rendering** | Code highlighting, image preview, link opening, Mermaid diagrams, footnotes, superscript and subscript |
| 🌐 **HTML rendering** | Based on WebView, preserves full CSS styling |
| 🔍 **Search and sort** | Sort by name or modification time, with real-time search filtering |
| 🎨 **Theme switching** | Light / dark / follow system, plus a brown-toned Sepia eye-care mode |
| 🔠 **Reading customization** | Adjustable font size, line spacing, and margins, with common presets |
| ✂️ **Text selection** | Long press to select; Markdown syntax markers are stripped automatically when copying |
| 📋 **Document management** | Rename any document, remove or delete it, and record reading progress |
| 📊 **Reading progress** | A progress bar at the top shows the current reading position |
| 🔄 **Check for updates** | Automatically detects new versions and jumps to the download with one click |

## Download and Installation

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Latest version | [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/alexopenfan-xiaxin/jianxi-reader/releases/latest) |
| System requirements | Android 7.0+ / API 24+ |
| Recommended system | Android 12+, for a more complete experience |
| CPU architecture | ARM64 (v8a), 64-bit devices |…

because-of-you/component.body:
# component

`component` is a Helm Charts repository for maintaining personal Kubernetes components.

This repository manages in one place its own Charts, wrappers for third-party Charts, environment override configuration, image builds, and the OCI publishing workflow. The goal is that each component can be checked and packaged independently, and distributed via Helm OCI.

## Features

- Maintains Kubernetes components based on Helm v3
- Supports wrapping third-party Charts and maintaining their own default values
- Supports appending custom resources to third-party Charts
- Supports dev environment override configuration
- Supports local rendering and deployment via Helmfile
- Supports automatic CI execution for changed Charts
- Supports automatic publishing of the dev branch to the GHCR OCI Registry
- Supports future extension to Docker image builds and formal version release workflows

## Quick Start

Install dependencies:

```bash
make deps
```

Lint Charts:

```bash
make lint
```

Render Charts:

```bash
make template
```

Package Charts:

```bash
make package
```

## Using OCI Charts

The dev branch publishes a fixed version:

```text
0.0.0-dev
```

Using Redis as an example:

```bash
helm registry login ghcr.io

helm upgrade --install redis oci://ghcr.io/because-of-you/charts/redis \
  --version 0.0.0-dev \
  --namespace infra \
  --create-namespace
```

Overriding default values:

```bash
helm upgrade --install redis oci://ghcr.io/because-of-you/charts/redis \
  --version 0.0.0-dev \
  --namespace infra \
  --create-namespace \
  -f values.yaml
```

Common component startup commands:

  --version 0.0.0-dev \
  --namespace infra \

# Codex Remote Bridge/Use Codex on your phone as easily as Doubao

Optional voice read-aloud for the web interface: completed reasoning summaries and final replies can call Volcano TTS on demand. Voice is off by default. joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin live room go-live monitor

Automatically monitors a set of Douyin live rooms. Once a room goes live or ends its broadcast, a notification is pushed to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification uses the Douyin URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`) to open Douyin directly in the corresponding live room.

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room-id one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream address?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Mark as live]
    E -- No --> G[Mark as offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with last state]
    H --> I[If state changed, send Bark]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Detection basis: the `liveStatus` field in Douyin's web SSR data also returns `normal` for rooms that are live (not reliable). However, offline room pages have zero real stream addresses such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url`, while live rooms have many. Therefore, "the page contains real stream addresses" is used as the reliable signal for being live. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent for that check (to prevent false alarms).

## File overview

- `monitor.py`: Main program. Reads rooms.txt, detects live status, sends Bark notifications, and writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt`: Monitoring list. Only this file needs to be edited; monitor.py does not need to be touched.
- `state.json`: Runtime state (last live status), maintained automatically by the program and added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1`: Script for adding rooms locally from the command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py`: Python version of the same functionality (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml`: GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt format

One room per line, in the form `link or identifier, display name`, separated by a comma:

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, Teacher Zicheng's family education talks
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, Yuchuan e-commerce

- The display name can be omitted (short links automatically look up the nickname using sec_uid).
- Supported:
  - Numeric room ID / Douyin ID (username)
  - `live.douyin.com/room-id`
  - `v.douyin.com/xxxx`…

# SC Funds

Dashboard for screening funds purchasable through Standard Chartered China, with holdings look-through, period returns, and portfolio backtesting.

Online: [https://john.js.org/scfunds/](https://john.js.org/scfunds/)

China mainland access: [https://scfunds.jozhn.com/](https://scfunds.jozhn.com/)

## Running locally

```bash
npm ci
npm run update-data
npm run dev
```

The dev server reads `public/data/funds.json` by default.

Data is split by purpose, and the page load order is designed around this:

- `public/data/funds.json`: fund list, period metrics, holdings, fees, and the most recent few days of NAV. Only this file is parsed on the first screen.
- `public/data/history/<fund>.json`: daily historical NAV for each fund (about 70KB). Loaded on demand when opening a fund's details or running a portfolio backtest; the frontend caches it per session.

After the first screen, data is cached persistently in the browser by `public/sw.js` (Service Worker): data files return cached content first and update silently in the background, while hashed static assets are cached permanently. The data directory can point to your own CDN via `VITE_DATA_BASE`.

## Common commands

```bash
npm run update-data  # Re-fetch fund list, historical returns, holdings, fees, and exchange rates
npm run lint         # oxlint check
npm run build        # Build the static site
```

## GitHub Pages

The repository is published at:

```text
https://john.js.org/scfunds/
```

`.github/workflows/pages.yml` deploys the static site using the official GitHub Pages Actions:

- Push to `main`: builds and deploys using the `public/data/` already in the repository.
- Manual run of `Build and deploy GitHub Pages`: runs `npm run update-data` first by default, then builds and deploys.

Before the first deployment, go to the GitHub repository's Settings -> Pages and set Build and deployment > Source to `GitHub Actions`.

labring/fastgpt-home.body:
# FastGPT Home

FastGPT official website home page, built with Next.js 16 + React 19.

🌐 https://fastgpt.io

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 (Turbopack)
- React 19
- TailwindCSS
- HeroUI
- Cloudflare Workers Static Assets

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

The business consultation form requires the CRM API address to be configured at build time (it must include `/api/v1`):

```bash
NEXT_PUBLIC_CRM_API_URL=https://crm.example.com/api/v1 npm run build
```

Also add the website domain to `CORS_ORIGINS` in the CRM service. If `NEXT_PUBLIC_CRM_API_URL` is not configured, the form will explicitly show a CRM-not-configured error and will not submit any data.

If the website form link itself does not carry `?source=...`, you can set Home's default business source with a build-time variable:

```bash
NEXT_PUBLIC_ATTRIBUTION_SOURCE=home \
NEXT_PUBLIC_CRM_API_URL=https://crm.example.com/api/v1 \
npm run build
```

An explicit `source` query parameter takes precedence over this default. If the variable is not configured, it falls back to `未知` (meaning "unknown"). This variable is public build configuration, so do not put keys or other sensitive information in it.

The business form's source uses the separate `source` query parameter, for example `/zh/contact?source=feishu`. On each submission, the site reads the current URL's `source` in real time. If the parameter is absent, the build-time default is used, and if that is not configured, the value is `未知` ("unknown"). Submission source does not read cookies or other local attribution state. UTM parameters can still be used for anonymous channel analytics, but they do not participate in the form submission source and are no longer used as the Feishu customer source. The explicit `source` is only sent to the CRM when a business opportunity is submitted. The form API only accepts form fields, `visitor_id`, and `source`; UTM/channel fields are sent separately by the anonymous visitor reporting API.

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

Build output goes to the `out/` directory (static export) and is hosted via Nginx or Cloudflare Workers Static Assets.

## Docker

```bash
docker build \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_VARIANT=cn \
  --build-arg…
```

### clone
If you need to clone this repository and submit content, be sure to use a single-branch clone. The single-branch clone is about 1G (images files). A full clone is too large at 4g (being optimized).
```
git clone -b master --single-branch https://github.com/mdark-org/btnews
```

### 2025

The main branch has removed all documentation framework and is now a pure documentation repository. It is part of MDARK.
See [https://github.com/mdark-org](https://github.com/mdark-org) for details.
A GitHub Action runs daily to scrape UP video updates.

### 2024.12.20

As 睡前消息 resumed updates, this archive repository has also resumed updating.

Because the WeChat official account publishes scripts slowly and some sections have no script updates, the original WeChat scraping script no longer applies.

The current update process is as follows:
1. Trigger the GitHub Action on a schedule or manually
2. The GitHub Action automatically fetches video information and determines which videos need to be generated
3. Download the video content and convert it to mp3 with ffmpeg
4. Call the dify workflow to produce the final script
   4.1 Input the audio file and call the speech2text model (whisper) to generate text
   4.2 Process the speech2text output with an LLM: add punctuation, split paragraphs, mark ad segments, and produce the final result
5. Automatically submit a PR
6. Manually review the PR, fix recognition errors, and merge.

Known problems with this process:
1. Compared with other mature speech recognition APIs, recognition accuracy may not be sufficient, at 90%+
2. Content has omissions: on average 1–2 places per article (50–100 characters) are missing because the speech2text model ignores them directly.
3. Manual review is slow

sersert/IncidentGPT.body:
# IncidentGPT — alert enrichment and correlation with AI analysis

> 💡 **Tip:** the secret keys `auth-shared-secret` and `hash-key` are generated with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

Two small Go services on top of your Prometheus/Alertmanager that:

1. **Enrich** each alert with context: metrics from Prometheus (with trends) + status of pods/nodes/events from the Kubernetes API.
2. **Correlate** an alert cascade into a single incident (by namespace + time window).
3. Ask an LLM to write a **draft analysis**: the likely root cause and what to check.
4. Send everything to **Telegram**: raw alerts one by one + the analysis.
5. Show incidents in the **web interface**, if it is enabled.

> This is not 'AI instead of an engineer'. The output is a draft; a human makes the decision.

---

## Documentation

Full documentation and an interactive guide are available on GitHub Pages:

https://sersert.github.io/IncidentGPT/

## Telegram setup

- [Telegram setup in Russian](https://github.com/sersert/IncidentGPT/blob/HEAD/docs/telegram-setup.ru.md)
- [Telegram setup guide in English](https://github.com/sersert/IncidentGPT/blob/HEAD/docs/telegram-setup.en.md)

---

## How it works

```
Cluster / nodes

# Glitch Studio (⚠️Under Development!!!)

[Open the app](https://syuilo.dev/glitch-studio/) · [User guide](https://syuilo.dev/glitch-studio/docs/)

Glitch Studio is an integrated image and video editing environment that can be used for real-time image and video processing, editing, and creation, as well as a shader playground.

- All image processing is performed on the GPU, so it is highly efficient
- In principle resolution-independent, so it renders consistent results with the same appearance at any resolution
- In principle fps-independent, so the speed of motion stays the same at any frame rate and results are consistent
- In principle aspect-ratio-independent, so it renders without distortion at any aspect ratio and results are consistent
- In principle deterministic, so the same parameters produce the same results regardless of environment
- In principle alpha-aware, so images containing transparency information can be rendered
- Parameters can be evaluated in various ways. Expressions can be interpreted as [AiScript](https://aiscript-dev.github.io/ja/)
- The UI thread, audio processing thread, and image processing thread are separated, so it takes advantage of multiple cores and runs fast
- Usable as both a web application and a desktop application

Depending on your ideas, you can create all kinds of things. The possibilities are unlimited.

> [!warning]
> It is currently in an early stage of development, so it is unstable and many features do not work!!
> Also, compatibility of project files is not guaranteed at this stage! Please refrain from using it for important projects.

Glitch Studio is composed of several subsystems.

## Visual Module

A system that processes data by wiring together various "nodes".

A node is like a function: it takes input (some take none) and returns output.

"Data" is not necessarily an image; it can be a scalar field or a vector field. In other words, any data in which some component is arranged in a two-dimensional array is a target for computation (processing). In that sense, it can also be called GPGPU.

That said, what is ultimately output is an image (video).

Glitch Studio deliberately allows outputs and inputs of different types to be connected (there is also an option to perform strict checking)。…
